mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sessions (activity_id, start_time, end_time, booking_deadline, price_cents, capacity, available, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{bookingDeadline}, #{priceCents}, #{capacity}, #{available}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sessions SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT','PENDING_CONFIRMATION','CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','REFUNDING') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o.id AND oi.session_id=#{sessionId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_allocations oa WHERE oa.order_id=o.id AND oa.session_id=#{sessionId}))
